item.title: Notes
item.description:
Below are some of my notes for many more or less standard materials. Most of them are hand-written, I might type them up sometime next spring.

  • Algebraic K-Theory
    Based on Milnor’s Introduction to Algebraic K-Theory.

  • Homotopical Algebra
    Based on Quillen’s Homotopical Algebra.

  • Topological K-Theory
    Based on Atiyah’s K-Theory.

  • Simplicial Presheaves
    Based on Jardine’s Simplicial Presheaves.

  • Triangulated Categories
    Based on Holm and Jørgensen’s Triangulated categories: definitions, properties, and examples.

  • Characteristic Classes
    Based on Milnor and Stasheff’s Characteristic Classes.

item.title: Reading
item.description:
There are too much mathematics that I wish to study but haven’t. If you are interested in reading something together, feel free to reach out!

Some books that I planned to read since a long time ago but still haven’t found a chance:

  • Differential Forms in Algebraic Topology by Tu and Bott

  • Higher Topos Theory and Higher Algebra by Lurie

  • Whitehead Torsion by Milnor

  • Rational Points on Elliptic Curves by Silverman and Tate
